newsitem.title: UK: ICCO lists buffer stock cocoa for sale in April.
newsitem.headline: ICCO lists buffer stock cocoa for sale in April.

text.p: The buffer stock manager of the International Cocoa Organization (ICCO) announced on Monday the buffer stock sales planned for April would total a maximum 4,250 tonnes and would comprise the following cocoa, an ICCO press release said.
The date of the sale has yet to be announced.
The following parcels to be sold on description:
TONNES ORIGIN PORT CROP YEAR QUALITY
The following parcels to be sold on description, contract terms subject to rules and regulations for in store cocoa:
The following parcels to be sold as per sample drawn and approved by buyers:
TONNES ORIGIN PORT CROP QUALITY WAREHOUSE
100 Cote d'Ivoire Amsterdam 1980/81 FAQ Nedveem b.v.
214 Cote d'Ivoire Amsterdam 1981/82 FAQ Nedveem b.v.
99 Cote d'Ivoire Amsterdam 1987/88 FAQ Nedveem b.v.
